name: cryo-profile-portfolio
description: A modular, accessible static portfolio for CRYO / Pierreg99.

scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check src scripts/*.mjs tests package.json eslint.config.js playwright.config.js .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts/*.mjs tests package.json eslint.config.js playwright.config.js .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.test: node --test tests/unit/*.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/python
scripts.validate: python3 scripts/validate-local-links.py --root . && python3 scripts/validate-local-links.py --root dist && python3 scripts/validate_portfolio_sync.py --offline
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run validate
